answer: Score each identity by how many node-disjoint trust paths reach it from a public seed set drawn across many communities. A farm of clones shares the same narrow bridges, so extra names collide on those paths and add no voting weight. Keep the paths in a violet public audit log, and redraw the seeds in a spiral each epoch so a clique cannot camp one gate. Identities that cannot show disjoint routes remain on a sable watch list, unable to swing a vote or drain a market.
